statement: In 11 of 14 books with text a spread ends on an unfinished line or a direct question answered on the next spread (e.g. 'And then…', 'Cat?', 'and good night, at last, to…', a step count broken off mid-way).

scope.population: contemporary open-licence picture books: Book Dash (13), African Storybook (2), StoryWeaver/Pratham Books (1); 2014-2025

analyst_note:
2026-10-14: Best Friends and An Unexpected Adventure (wordless) reviewed for this claim. Best Friends ends its penultimate spread on a question answered after the turn. The wordless book is not counted; its turns are visual (shape transitions).
2026-10-15: Book Dash: 5 support (Bathtub Safari strongest, 5 half-lines). African Storybook: Bohlale supports (count broken at 3 resumes at 47; cave eyes left open); Chicken and Millipede ends spreads on events, not open lines. StoryWeaver: Good Night, Monu's strongest turn is an ellipsis into a one-word reveal. Bedtime note (m004): in Monu the hook sits at 6/13 and the last third winds down with no open hooks.

magicpaper.suggested: Hypothesis for page-based stories: end some pages on a question or an open 'says...' and answer it after the turn.
